text: If you are evaluating an agent-driven content tool, ask which of its actions change something outside the tool, and whether those actions are named for what they are. Ask what happens to a sign-off when the draft is edited after it was given. Ask whether one sign-off can be used twice, or by two jobs at once. Ask whose name is recorded when a machine account carries out a job that a person signed off. When you assess any tool that writes to your website, ask what it does when it cannot tell whether a write went through.
